title: Selected profile that cannot be read keeps its owner lock until the page closes (B1)
title_th: โปรไฟล์ที่อ่านไม่ได้ยังถือ lock เจ้าของไว้จนปิดหน้า ทำให้แท็บอื่น (รุ่นใหม่) เปิดได้แค่อ่านอย่างเดียว (B1)
status_evidence: origin/main da67341 src/workspace/repository.ts:249 `const release = await this.hold(selected), record = this.read(selected);` — if read() throws, the catch at :254 runs this.release?.() while this.release is still null, so the Web Lock is never released. R2 touched only registry.ts (+telemetryLayout key) in src/workspace.
placement: new R sub-task R1.6 "Storage hardening" (owner L; dialog strings L-UI; no main.ts) — scheduled right after the R2 close-out, before R3.5/R5/R6 add write traffic
priority_rationale: Data safety: during a service-worker update an old tab that reads a newer record keeps the lock, so the new tab opens read-only and rename/delete fail everywhere; XS fix.
acceptance: Assign this.release = release before read(); keep read after hold. New unit test (tests/workspace-profiles.test.ts): selected record newer/invalid -> initialize() -> a second repository on the same Locks double gets status durable (today locked). workspace-profiles and workspace-bootstrap suites green unchanged.
quality_guard: Success path byte-identical; only the error path releases the lock. No change to the R1.1 visit-only policy.
user_benefit: A newer-version or damaged profile no longer locks every other tab into read-only mode.

placement: new R sub-task R1.6 "Storage hardening" (owner L; dialog strings L-UI; no main.ts) — scheduled right after the R2 close-out, before R3.5/R5/R6 add write traffic

status_evidence: origin/main src/pwa/sw-core.ts precache(): `scope.fetch(url, { cache: "reload" })` for every manifest entry not in an older cache. perf-baseline (fbefa18): 18 requests / 9.46 MB to interactive, then 70 requests / 15.74 MB after, of which 9.35 MB are the same paths again. The baseline server sends no-cache without validators, so the saving on GitHub Pages (max-age=600 + ETag) must be measured with Pages-like headers before it is claimed.
placement: E (track E, identical output; owner T/PWA; package "precache transfer")
priority_rationale: Biggest identical-output saving on the first visit (Thai prepaid data, school Wi-Fi); no quality trade-off because bytes are verified.
acceptance: Fetch with the default cache mode, compute contentRevision (sha-256, already used by the repair path) and compare with entry.revision; on mismatch re-fetch with cache:"reload". quality_guard: The cache holds byte-identical files (revision-verified), so offline completeness and update safety are unchanged; only transfer is removed.
user_benefit: First install on a phone or school network uses up to ~9 MB less data and finishes sooner.
